rules.text: Purchases made from February 1 at 11:59am ET can be returned for any reason within 90 days for a refund or exchange.
rules.quote: Any purchase made from February 1 at 11:59am ET can be returned for any reason for a refund of the purchase price, minus the S&H and Q Return Label fee, or exchanged for a free replacement of the same item in a different color or size.

rules.text: Food items are excluded from the 90-Day Extended Return Policy.
rules.quote: Food, personalized items, and gift cards are excluded.

rules.text: Blowout Clearance Price items are excluded from the 90-Day Extended Return Policy and can only be returned for defects or QVC errors.
rules.quote: QVC's 90-Day Extended Return Policy does not apply to Blowout Clearance Price items. QVC will only accept returns or exchanges for product defects or QVC errors.
